assets.prompt: Create polished warm 3D clay storybook illustrations for Family School 360 children ages 4–8, jade teal, cream, coral and honey gold, clear consistent characters, soft daylight, no watermark. Portrait 4:5 app cover. Open large book creates a story world. Two Arab children about 6, girl coral shirt and boy jade shirt, adult supportive companion. Story cards of turquoise cup, orange cat in open box, golden ball. Top clear dark emerald title EXACT Arabic "حكاية وكلمة", subtitle EXACT "أسمع وأقرأ وأؤلف". Bottom discreet "4–8" and "مدرسة العائلة 360". Sophisticated crafted paper and wood textures, welcoming, not babyish, restrained sparkles.

Create polished warm 3D clay storybook illustrations for Family School 360 children ages 4–8, jade teal, cream, coral and honey gold, clear consistent characters, soft daylight, no watermark. Square exact 2x2 four equal panels edge to edge with no gutters, no text or numbers. Same Arab girl 6, coral shirt, dark shoulder hair, same safe low table, green book and turquoise cup. TOP LEFT girl places visible cup beside flat book. TOP RIGHT upright book fully hides cup while girl looks for it. BOTTOM LEFT girl moves upright book sideways revealing cup. BOTTOM RIGHT girl holds recovered cup with both hands smiles, book flat again. No spills/danger. Each quarter a complete clear scene.
